input_images.role: Approved original portrait, replace backdrop only

presentation: Opaque portrait, neutral dark section, no section glow or portrait masks. 4:5 frame with 4px corners, 84% column width capped at 420px.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the background of the supplied approved photograph only.
Replace its dark studio background with a solid, uniform, matte smoky plum colour approximately #302633. It must be a flat single-colour backdrop, the same colour behind the hair, face, neck and shoulders. No gradient, no glow, no vignette, no halo, no texture, no paint effects. Keep the colour muted and sophisticated.
Preserve the original foreground photograph as faithfully as possible: the exact same man, face, subtle smile, hair, skin texture, pose, earphone details, cable and knit top. Do not reinterpret or beautify the face, do not change the expression or relight the subject. No plum or pink colour spill on his skin.
Keep the existing 4:5 composition, subject scale, position and crop unchanged. Do not zoom out or zoom in.
Output a fully opaque photograph with a solid smoky plum background. No transparent areas, text, logos or borders. The only change is the flat background colour.
